name: train_model
title: Train a model on practice questions
description: Start fine-tuning a model (LoRA) on a reviewed question set, with each question paired with the excerpts search finds for it and some 'not covered' examples. Training runs in the background; this returns the run id at once. Large models load in 4-bit when the GPU needs it.

questions.description: Path of a question set from write_practice_questions.

model.description: Base model id, for example Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.

name.description: A short name for the run.
